scope: Real Unity Editor Game View at 1280x720, 1600x720 and 960x720, plus the compact default at 1160x720. Seeded room; AI/economy frozen, real unscaled presentation time, real affordability and path-blocking rules. Optional recording advances an editor-only presentation clock by 1/30 second per rendered frame; it is offline presentation evidence. Desktop visual/functional evidence, not Android phone performance. Screenshot metadata retained from the preceding same-source fixture run; recording and interaction assertions rerun independently. Prior attempt report retained beside this report.
beatAssertions: Rendered Summon glow rises by more than 0.35 between rest and peak.
Live Summon releases retain at least a 0.4-second gap.
Every complete primary Summon beat in the recording lasts 2.5–3.0 seconds.
Each primary release has a synchronized glow peak above 0.9 within eight recorded frames.
interactionAssertions: Press does not place or charge immediately; repeated press queues only one summon.
After the 0.22-second press, one selected tower is placed and charged once.
Losing affordability during the press cancels placement without charging.
Closing during the press cancels the pending summon and retains the wallet.
Actual type-rail Tap callback selects a valid bullets tower.
Actual type-rail Tap callback selects a valid fire tower.
Actual type-rail Tap callback selects a valid electric tower.
Actual type-rail Tap callback selects a valid effects tower.
Actual type-rail Tap callback selects a valid resources tower.
Actual cubby Drag/Release callbacks move the preview onto another free plate and release the floating card.
